blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Wetlands, coastal habitats and agricultural lands in Quezon province continue to provide vital sanctuaries for migratory birds, the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) said. In a report released Friday (Oct. 16), DENR-Calabarzon said the 2026 Asian Waterbird Census documented 229 birds belonging to 16 species at two monitoring sites in the province. These areas are the rice fields in Barangay Pamplona in General Nakar, and Baluti Island in Barangay Cawayan, Real. Among the species recorded were the Little Egret (Egretta garzetta), Intermediate Egret (Ardea intermedia), Great Egret (Ardea alba), Cattle Egret (Bubulcus ibis), Indian Pond Heron […]...
